author: 3owj
content: D1: journal path now emitted for Topic scope in _session.md. D2: course-review.md Phase 3 fixed — no more inline content field, shows kind:journal op + write-file-first contract. D3: create_note precondition now branches on kind — journal only needs file to exist; atomic/index keep old logic. D4: CreateNotePathMissing error variant added, used instead of UpdateNotePathMissing for absent file in create_note. merge_back: also copies _journal/ from workspace to vault (append-only, no stale removal). NoteKind::Journal added to enum; reindex/report_schema_cmd updated.
